title: Writer Seed
description: One seed: an actionable question a writer can be asked, derived verbatim from a craft-book claim. Runtime payload for the consumer model is `question` only; `verb` and `source` are audit/integrity fields, never fed at runtime.

question.description: The seed. 1-2 short imperative sentences, addressed to the writer (you). Self-contained: no book titles, no author names. A small model reshapes it against live text.

verb.description: Intervention kind, classified from the question's own action. Audit/coverage field only - never fed to the runtime model.

genre.description: Craft-application genres this seed applies to, judged from the claim's context. Use genre-agnostic when it crosses all of them. The one runtime-relevant axis: the consumer selects by it.

quote.description: Verbatim source sentence(s) the seed derives from. Copied exactly - no paraphrase, no repair. Anti-hallucination anchor; never fed to the runtime model.
